name: Let me Live PEACEFULLY
source:
After reincarnating into the universe of the children’s cartoon show, True Forces Unite, Jade must survive the turmoil of their new life as an NPC during the show’s Halloween special. Scavenging for food with monsters running amok, dealing with haughty henchmen, and goofy protagonist antics, Jade must persevere above all the chaos if they want to live a quieter life than their last!

[From [url=https://wolfinred.itch.io/let-me-live-peacefully]itch.io[/url]]
